news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 1 experienced director. 8 highly experienced directors. 3 independent directors (6 non-independent directors). Independent Non-Executive Director Vaibhav Jain was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2019. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Insufficient board refreshment.

news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.40 (vs ₹0.37 in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.40 (up from ₹0.37 in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹220.1m (down 1.1% from 1H 2025). Net income: ₹6.76m (up 33% from 1H 2025). Profit margin: 3.1% (up from 2.3% in 1H 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses.
